title: Better Ghast Harness DEFAULT 16x
description: The 16x version of my Better Ghast Harness that restores the Default texture to the regular ghasts and gives it to the happy ghast!
body:
**THIS RESOURCE PACK IS NOT TO BE REUPLOADED BY ITSELF ANYWHERE BY ANYONE EXCEPT MidniteDemolisher.**

---

**This resource pack may be included in modpacks to be distributed! Please do not remove my credit.**

---

I made a Programmer Art version, so may I present a Default version of my Better Ghast Harness!

### **WHAT TO EXPECT:**
- Regular ghasts are restored to their Default texture
- Happy ghasts match the Default ghasts
- The harness is 16x
- All colors of the harness were done
- The harness is my overhaul of it, not Mojang's vanilla harness
- The blue ghastling is in this pack too!

**Prefer the upscaled harness? Don't like the goggles? Want more options? Programmer Art and the updated texture versions with goggles can be found on my Modrinth page, and versions without the goggles can be found on my [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/members/midnitedemolisher/projects)! Modrinth doesn't allow multiple different files under one project, and I would have 9 different projects if I uploaded all the versions here, which is too much for one single thing for me XD**
